sites.name: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital
sites.event: The first capital of the centralized feudal state of Vietnam (10th century), associated with the Dinh and Early Le dynasties.

sites.name: Trang An Landscape Complex
sites.event: The only World Cultural and Natural Heritage site (dual heritage) in Southeast Asia, and the filming location of the blockbuster 'Kong: Skull Island'.

place.commune: Truong Yen Commune, Ninh Xuan Commune, Gia Sinh Commune...
place.district: Hoa Lu District, Gia Vien District, Ninh Binh City

sites.name: Tam Coc - Bich Dong
sites.event: Known as the 'second finest cave under the Southern sky' and 'Ha Long Bay on land', famous for its golden ripe rice season along the Ngo Dong River.

sites.name: Bai Dinh Pagoda
sites.event: The largest pagoda complex in Southeast Asia, holding many Vietnamese and Asian records (the largest bronze Buddha statue, the longest Arhat corridor...).

sites.name: Phat Diem Stone Cathedral
sites.event: A unique Catholic architectural complex built entirely of stone and wood, harmoniously combining Western Gothic style with Eastern temples and pagodas.

sites.name: Cuc Phuong National Park
sites.event: The first national park of Vietnam (established in 1962), famous for its butterfly season and the thousand-year-old Cho tree.

sites.name: Mua Cave
sites.event: Likened to a 'miniature Great Wall', where the Tran kings of the past often visited to listen to royal concubines and maids sing, play music, and dance.

sites.name: Van Long Nature Reserve
sites.event: The largest wetland nature reserve in the Northern Delta, home to the rare white-rumped langur.

sites.name: Am Tien Cave (Tuyet Tinh Coc)
sites.event: The place where Empress Dowager Duong Van Nga practiced her religion in her final years, and was once an execution ground during the reign of King Dinh Tien Hoang (Ao Giai, Hang Muoi).

sites.name: Thung Nham Bird Park
sites.event: An ecotourism area famous for its large natural bird park, where thousands of storks fly back to their nests at sunset.

sites.name: Thai Vi Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for the Tran kings (Tran Thai Tong, Tran Thanh Tong, Tran Nhan Tong, Tran Anh Tong) and generals of the Tran dynasty.

sites.name: Kenh Ga - Van Trinh
sites.event: Famous for the Kenh Ga hot mineral spring and the shimmering Van Trinh Cave.
